svg.text: Jono · @jchin14
7.3 years on GitHub
ABOUT
WORK WITH ME
Hey, I'm Jono, a final-year engineering student in Melbourne
who's into embedded hardware, RF/comms and networks, and a
little obsessed with 5G deployments, spectrum and RAN. I've
designed 18 PCBs for Monash Nova Rover, led its 15-person
electrical team and helped bring home 5 international podiums.
I've shrunk a neonatal research sensor's PCB by 58%, built a
PoE sensor for 94% less than off-the-shelf, designed Wi-Fi for
50+ clients and taught 1,800+ students. And when a gadget
won't tell me how it works, I open it up and find out.
Open to embedded, RF & comms roles
Graduating 2026 · Melbourne · open to relocation
PCB design · firmware · CAN · RF
5G deployments · spectrum · RAN
Wi-Fi & networks · UniFi · VLANs
Altium Accredited PCB Design (Advanced)
github@jchin.au →
WHAT I'M BUILDING
Monash Nova Rover
Led a 15-person team through 13 modular PCBs, a
CAN-FD migration and a Jetson Orin integration.
Neonatal sensor probe
Summer research upgrading an ESP32 sensor probe:
58% smaller PCB and 2× the telemetry rate.
unifi-device-bridge
Reverse-engineered UniFi's inform/adoption protocol so
SNMP and TP-Link switches adopt as native UniFi gear.
binarypb.jchin.au
Protobuf editor for Shannon modem UE-capability
profiles: bulk CA-combo edits, Magisk module export.
netBae
Zero-dependency Python network monitor: latency, DNS,
jitter and speedtests 24/7 on Pi, UniFi OS or Docker.
doorBae + metroBae
Cloudflare Workers edge API fusing GTFS and GTFS-RT
feeds into a kiosk board and a React Native iOS app.
messageBae
Electron macOS Messenger client: keyboard-first, menu
bar badge and mute, native menus over Meta's dialogs.
unifi-ddns6
IPv6 dynamic DNS UniFi lacks: tracks WAN prefix changes
and syncs AAAA/A records to Cloudflare, HE or DynDNS.
Making a dumb house smart
Reverse-engineered my Brivis air con's wall panel and
built an ESP32 bridge into Home Assistant and HomeKit.
Open-source contributions
unpoller: fixed Prometheus DPI dashboards dropping data
on quoted client names. Nova Rover: CAN bus speed-up.
cellular.jchin.au
My reference site for AU & NZ mobile networks:
spectrum holdings, RAN vendors and 5G rollouts.
JC Wireless
Designing and deploying UniFi Wi-Fi for homes and small
businesses around Melbourne. 2,000+ devices connected.
CONTRIBUTING & SUPPORT
Most of what I make is open source. Found a bug or want a feature? Open an issue or send a PR, I'm happy
to help. If something here saved you time, a star means a lot, or you can buy me a coffee at
buymeacoffee.com/jchin14. And if you're hiring for embedded, RF or comms, let's chat!
